children: Grayscale Dogecoin Trust ETF announced multiple updates to its operating infrastructure. The Trust added Anchorage Digital as an additional custodian for a portion of its DOGE, while Coinbase remains the primary custodian. It also amended Authorized Participant Agreements with Macquarie Capital (USA) and Virtu Americas to enable in-kind creations and redemptions alongside cash. These changes aim to improve liquidity, streamline primary market activity, and strengthen custody diversification as the Trust scales.
Agreement 1: Grayscale Dogecoin Trust Enables In-Kind Creations and Redemptions With Macquarie Capital
: Amendment to Authorized Participant Agreement for in-kind creations and redemptions
: Expand creation/redemption options and improve trading efficiency
Agreement 2: Grayscale Dogecoin Trust Expands In-Kind Creations and Redemptions With Virtu Americas
: Amendment to Authorized Participant Agreement for in-kind creations and redemptions
Agreement 3: Grayscale Dogecoin Trust Adds Anchorage Digital as Additional Custodian for DOGE
: Sixth Amendment to Master Custody Service Agreement; addition of Anchorage as custodian
: Diversify custody and enhance risk management
